title: Tiny, cute guitar
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body lower bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#E8703A'/>
  <!-- body upper bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='19' ry='16' fill='#F08048'/>
  <!-- waist blend highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='17' ry='10' fill='#E8703A'/>
  <!-- inner body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='17' ry='14' fill='#F79055'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#F79B60'/>
  <!-- sound hole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='7' fill='#5C2A10'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='4.5' fill='#7A3A18'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='39' y='78' width='22' height='6' rx='2' fill='#8A3A1A'/>
  <rect x='44' y='80' width='12' height='2' rx='1' fill='#C8E0F0'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='45.5' y='16' width='9' height='28' rx='2' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <!-- neck center highlight -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='17' width='3' height='26' rx='1.5' fill='#C87850'/>
  <!-- frets -->
  <rect x='45.5' y='24' width='9' height='1.2' fill='#E8D8B0'/>
  <rect x='45.5' y='30' width='9' height='1.2' fill='#E8D8B0'/>
  <rect x='45.5' y='36' width='9' height='1.2' fill='#E8D8B0'/>
  <!-- headstock -->
  <rect x='42.5' y='6' width='15' height='12' rx='3' fill='#8A4020'/>
  <!-- tuning pegs left -->
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='10' r='2' fill='#FFD24A'/>
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='15' r='2' fill='#FFD24A'/>
  <!-- tuning pegs right -->
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='10' r='2' fill='#FFD24A'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='15' r='2' fill='#FFD24A'/>
  <!-- strings -->
  <line x1='47.5' y1='17' x2='45' y2='79' stroke='#E8F4FF' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='52.5' y1='17' x2='55' y2='79' stroke='#E8F4FF' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='17' x2='50' y2='79' stroke='#E8F4FF' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- little sparkle -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='34' r='2' fill='#FFE894'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='40' r='1.4' fill='#FFE894'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='52' r='1.6' fill='#9EE8FF'/>
</svg>
